text:
GENERATE BURST CS-vfx-healing-sheets — greyscale PAINTED-PIXEL effect sheets for HEALING HANDS (breadth test kit 6: le-healing-hands-paladin; style card v0.2). task_id "CS-vfx-healing-sheets".

Paint ONE 1536×1024 image on flat PURE BLACK #000000 — the background is a BLACK VOID: NO grey fog, NO gradient, NO vignette, NO atmosphere, NO lighting on the background; every background pixel is exactly #000000 (this is the one hard rule; a grey or hazy background is a failed image). The flask glass is drawn MID GREY so it stays visible against black. a 6-column × 4-row grid of 256×256 cells (each effect drawing centred in its cell, never touching the cell edge), GREYSCALE ONLY (light grey → mid grey → dark grey → darker grey (use pure WHITE only for the tiniest fuse spark and the very centre of the flame cores, never for whole shapes), no colour), in a PAINTED-PIXEL register: each drawing looks like a hand-painted sprite at a small native size — hard-edged shapes, 3–4 flat value steps, a near-white core, dark grey rim/interior holes, ABSOLUTELY NO soft gradients, NO glow, NO haze, NO bloom, NO radial light falloff around any shape, NO blur, NO anti-aliasing, NO outline strokes: every pixel is one of exactly FIVE values — pure black background, dark grey #404040, mid grey #808080, light grey #C0C0C0, pure white #FFFFFF — with hard, stair-stepped edges as if drawn with a 1-px pencil at 64 px and scaled up 4x with nearest-neighbour. Think 1990s 16-bit sprite effects (Diablo I / Secret of Mana spell sprites) drawn in greyscale, NOT a modern glowing render. If you are tempted to make anything glow, draw a ring of light-grey pixels instead. Design it as a holy healing effect (soft-edged but PIXEL-drawn: rising light motes, a gentle burst of radiance from the hands, a wide ring of light on the ground, floating leaf/feather-like motes) even though it is greyscale; NO glow haze — draw the radiance as hard-edged rays and motes.
ROW 1 — CAST (6 frames): two small open-hand shapes cupped together with light motes gathering between them, growing to a compact radiant knot with short rays; frame 6 the knot flares.
ROW 2 — TRAVEL (6 frames): a small radiant pulse drawn facing RIGHT (a compact ray-star with a short trail of rising motes to the LEFT); each frame the rays rotate so they loop.
ROW 3 — IMPACT (6 frames): the heal lands: frame 1 a small ray-star at the target (no white disc); then a ring of short rays expands outward with motes rising; then the rays thin into floating motes; the last frame is a few rising motes.
ROW 4 — RESIDUAL + MOTE (6 frames): frames 1–4: a wide flat ring of light on the ground (an ellipse wider than tall) with motes rising from it, four looping variations of the same size; frames 5–6: one single rising light mote facing RIGHT (a small leaf-like mote), two variants.
Every drawing must read at 25 % size (64 px cells). Nothing between cells; no labels, grid lines, text or border; background pure black.

One image_gen call. ONE retry only if colour appears, any glow/haze/gradient appears, cells bleed into each other, or a row is missing — name the reason. Copy the output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/healing_sheets.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-vfx-healing-sheets"; images = the file with prompt, references and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
